title: The Coronavirus Outbreak in Washington State

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯汀·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 我们将对部分采访进行直播，供大家在11月18日于nytimes.com免费观看。

If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, a strategy of containment was supposed to protect Washington State from the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 今天，原本旨在保护华盛顿州免受冠状病毒侵害的遏制策略。

sentences.en: It didn't.
sentences.zh: 失败了。

sentences.en: Mike Baker, on what led to the first major outbreak in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 迈克·贝克将讲述导致美国首次重大疫情爆发的原因。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, March 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月5日，星期四。

sentences.en: Mike, tell me about how this outbreak in Washington State starts.
sentences.zh: 迈克，告诉我华盛顿州的这次疫情是如何开始的。

sentences.en: So it really began January 20th.
sentences.zh: 其实是从1月20日开始的。

sentences.en: Tonight, the CDC is confirming the first case in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今晚，美国疾控中心确认了美国首例。

sentences.en: of a new and deadly coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 新型致命冠状病毒病例。

sentences.en: A man in Washington State has the same virus that has sickened about 300 people in China, killing at least six.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州一名男子感染了同一种病毒，该病毒已在中国导致约300人患病，至少6人死亡。

sentences.en: That was when the officials here announced that the first case of coronavirus in the United States was in Washington State.
sentences.zh: 当时当地官员宣布，美国首例冠状病毒病例出现在华盛顿州。

sentences.en: It was in north of Seattle.
sentences.zh: 就在西雅图以北。

sentences.en: There was a man in his 40s who had been traveling to the Wuhan region in China.
sentences.zh: 那是一名40多岁的男子，曾前往中国武汉地区旅行。

sentences.en: He had come back.
sentences.zh: 他已经回国了。

sentences.en: He had developed symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 他出现了症状。

sentences.en: After he returned to the United States.
sentences.zh: 在他回到美国之后。

sentences.en: And as kind of a savvy guy, he certainly made the connection that he was potentially infected with the coronavirus and presented himself at a health
sentences.zh: 作为一个比较精明的人，他当然意识到自己可能感染了冠状病毒，并前往当地一家健康诊所寻求帮助。

sentences.en: clinic in the area to ask for some help.
sentences.zh: 诊所寻求帮助。

sentences.en: And what happens to him?
sentences.zh: 他后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: How is he treated?
sentences.zh: 他接受了怎样的治疗？

sentences.en: Officials there, the doctors take a sample.
sentences.zh: 那里的官员和医生采集了样本。

sentences.en: They're sending it off to the CDC.
sentences.zh: 他们将其送往疾控中心。

sentences.en: There's certainly an awareness that this very likely could be a case.
sentences.zh: 当时人们确实意识到这很有可能是一个确诊病例。

sentences.en: He ends up being taken to the hospital and quarantined there in a special portion of the hospital.
sentences.zh: 他最终被送往医院，并在医院的一个特殊区域进行了隔离。

sentences.en: You know, at that point, you have health officials sort of tracking down who was he on the plane with when he returned?
sentences.zh: 你知道，在那一刻，卫生官员开始追踪他回国时与谁同乘飞机？

sentences.en: How did he get from the airport back to his house?
sentences.zh: 他是怎么从机场回到家的？

sentences.en: What was he doing in the hours and days after he landed?
sentences.zh: 他落地后的几个小时和几天里都在做什么？

sentences.en: So there's a huge effort just to find out who might have been in contact with him to make sure that this wasn't going to be spreading further.
sentences.zh: 所以大家投入了巨大的努力，只是为了找出谁可能与他有过接触，以确保病毒不会进一步传播。

sentences.en: And what were the results of those efforts to track people he might have been in contact with?
sentences.zh: 那么追踪他可能接触过的人的努力结果如何？

sentences.en: They ended up tracking dozens of people and I don't believe any of them ended up developing symptoMs. We went six weeks here in Washington state without another case popping up.
sentences.zh: 他们最终追踪了数十人，据我所知，他们中没有人出现症状。在华盛顿州，我们有六周时间没有出现新病例。

sentences.en: There were a number of tests done on a couple dozen people and none came back positive.
sentences.zh: 对几十个人进行了多次检测，结果均为阴性。

sentences.en: So there was certainly a sense that the case that had shown up on the shores here was one that was contained.
sentences.zh: 所以当时确实有一种感觉，即出现在这里的病例已经得到了控制。

sentences.en: So far, so good.
sentences.zh: 目前为止，一切顺利。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In fact, there was a press conference last Thursday where the state still just had one confirmed case, the first case.
sentences.zh: 事实上，上周四举行了一场新闻发布会，当时该州仍只有一例确诊病例，也就是首例。

sentences.en: And they talked publicly about how the risk to the general public remained low.
sentences.zh: 他们公开表示，对普通民众的风险仍然很低。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: On Friday, you know, I'm working, helping colleagues around the West Coast track coronavirus cases that are starting to emerge.
sentences.zh: 周五，我当时正在工作，帮助西海岸的同事追踪开始出现的冠状病毒病例。

sentences.en: And there's cases in California, cases in Oregon.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州有病例，俄勒冈州也有病例。

sentences.en: And then I get a notification that at 8 p.m.
sentences.zh: 然后我收到通知，在晚上8点。

sentences.en: on Friday night, the health officials here in Washington state, we're going to have a press conference.
sentences.zh: 周五晚上，华盛顿州的卫生官员要召开新闻发布会。

sentences.en: And 8 p.m.
sentences.zh: 而晚上8点。

sentences.en: press conferences generally are not a sign that good information is about to come out.
sentences.zh: 召开新闻发布会通常不是什么好消息即将发布的迹象。

sentences.en: Fair.
sentences.zh: 有道理。

sentences.en: I'm Jeff Duchin.
sentences.zh: 我是杰夫·杜钦。

sentences.en: I'm the health officer for public health Seattle in King County.
sentences.zh: 我是西雅图和金县公共卫生部门的卫生官员。

sentences.en: And I'm here to share with you that we have a preliminary positive result for COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 我在这里告诉大家，我们有一个初步的COVID-19阳性结果。

sentences.en: So at that meeting, they have announced two new cases.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个会议上，他们宣布了两个新病例。

sentences.en: A woman in her 50s, a female who traveled to South Korea, was visiting.
sentences.zh: 一位50多岁的女性，她曾去韩国旅行，当时正在访问期间。

sentences.en: They have a woman who was traveling in South Korea, came back and tested positive.
sentences.zh: 他们有一位去韩国旅行的女性，回来后检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: And noted symptoms at the end of the workday when she got home on
sentences.zh: 她在周二下班回家时注意到了症状。

sentences.en: Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 周二。

sentences.en: And on Wednesday evening, her husband called to report her symptoms and travel history to us.
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，她的丈夫打电话向我们报告了她的症状和旅行史。

sentences.en: And we had her tested yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我们昨天为她做了检测。

sentences.en: And then they also had a teenager.
sentences.zh: 然后他们还有一个青少年病例。

sentences.en: As Dr. Lofi mentioned, we do have a new case of coronavirus in Snohomish County.
sentences.zh: 正如洛菲医生所提到的，斯诺霍米什县确实出现了新的冠状病毒病例。

sentences.en: A high schooler in the area whose tests came back positive as well.
sentences.zh: 当地一名高中生，他的检测结果也呈阳性。

sentences.en: Today for a school-aged adolescent, this individual became ill on Monday with fever, body aches and a headache.
sentences.zh: 今天，对于一名学龄青少年来说，此人在周一患病，伴有发烧、身体疼痛和头痛。

sentences.en: The remarkable thing about those two cases is here, the state and federal governments had been spending much of their time focused on
sentences.zh: 这两个病例最引人注目的是，州政府和联邦政府此前大部分时间都专注于追踪从武汉或中国大陆回来的人。

sentences.en: tracking people who had come back from Wuhan or from mainland China.
sentences.zh: 追踪从武汉或中国大陆回来的人。

sentences.en: Those are the people who are getting screened at the airports.
sentences.zh: 那些是在机场接受筛查的人。

sentences.en: Those are the people who are getting tested.
sentences.zh: 那些是接受检测的人。

sentences.en: And here we had two cases that really didn't fit that pattern at all.
sentences.zh: 而这里出现的两个病例完全不符合那种模式。

sentences.en: They weren't really on that standard set of guidelines where testing would have taken place.
sentences.zh: 他们并不在通常需要进行检测的指导方针范围内。

sentences.en: There was no travel history associated with this case.
sentences.zh: 该病例没有相关的旅行史。

sentences.en: Our team is still in the midst of the contact investigation.
sentences.zh: 我们的团队仍在进行接触者调查。

sentences.en: So we do not yet know the possible source of infection.
sentences.zh: 所以我们还不知道可能的感染源。

sentences.en: Along with cases in Oregon and California, we're sort of setting this new standard that this wasn't just people coming back from China anymore.
sentences.zh: 随着俄勒冈州和加利福尼亚州出现病例，我们正在设定一个新的标准，即这不再仅仅是人们从中国回来的问题了。

sentences.en: There were people who were in our communities who are getting the virus and no one really knew where it was coming from.
sentences.zh: 社区里有人感染了病毒，没人真正知道病毒是从哪里来的。

sentences.en: And so in the middle of these questions about whether we're testing the right people, whether the regimen around
sentences.zh: 因此，在关于我们是否在检测正确的人，以及全国范围内的检测方案是否能捕捉到可能已经存在的病例这些问题中，新闻出现了升级。

sentences.en: the country is going to catch the cases that might be here already, there's an escalation in the news.
sentences.zh: 全国范围内的检测方案是否能捕捉到可能已经存在的病例这些问题中，新闻出现了升级。

sentences.en: Today, Public Health Seattle and King County is announcing three new presumptive positive cases of novel coronavirus, COVID-19, including one person who died.
sentences.zh: 今天，西雅图和金县公共卫生部门宣布了三例新的新型冠状病毒（COVID-19）推定阳性病例，其中包括一名死亡患者。

sentences.en: And I want to just start by expressing our deep and sincere condolences to the family members and loved ones of the person who died.
sentences.zh: 我想首先向死者的家人和亲人表达我们深切而诚挚的慰问。

sentences.en: A Washington State man has now died of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州一名男子现已死于冠状病毒。

sentences.en: It's the first death in the United
sentences.zh: 这是美国的第一例死亡病例。

sentences.en: States.
sentences.zh: 美国。

sentences.en: It's a man in his 50s in the Seattle area who lived at a nursing home.
sentences.zh: 这是一名住在疗养院的西雅图地区50多岁的男子。

sentences.en: The person who died was a patient at Evergreen Hospital who had underlying health conditions.
sentences.zh: 死者是长青医院的一名患者，患有基础疾病。

sentences.en: And he had not traveled abroad either.
sentences.zh: 而且他也没有去过国外。

sentences.en: We now have got three cases in Washington State, not connected to China, two of which appear to have developed the virus within the community somewhere.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在华盛顿州有三例与中国无关的病例，其中两例似乎是在社区内感染的病毒。

sentences.en: And so the announcements come out.
sentences.zh: 于是公告发布了。

sentences.en: Governor Jay Inslee declares a state of emergency.
sentences.zh: 州长杰伊·英斯利宣布进入紧急状态。

sentences.en: The governor suggests the use of potentially the National Guard if needed.
sentences.zh: 州长建议在必要时可能动用国民警卫队。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And then the, you know, the main area of focus that emerged at that point was this nursing facility in Kirkland in the Seattle suburbs owned by a company called Life Care.
sentences.zh: 然后，当时出现的主要关注点是西雅图郊区柯克兰的一家疗养院，该疗养院由一家名为Life Care的公司拥有。

sentences.en: The officials were reporting that potentially dozens of people were sick there.
sentences.zh: 官员们报告说，那里可能有几十人患病。

sentences.en: They're showing signs of symptoms, a mix of both residents and staff.
sentences.zh: 他们表现出症状迹象，包括居民和工作人员。

sentences.en: And obviously this is just, it's like a terrible place for a coronavirus to take root.
sentences.zh: 显然，这对于冠状病毒扎根来说是一个可怕的地方。

sentences.en: I mean, you've got people who are elderly, who have medical issues.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那里住着老年人，他们有医疗问题。

sentences.en: I mean, those are the exact types of people who would be most vulnerable to any kind of illness.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些人正是最容易受到任何疾病伤害的群体。

sentences.en: And there was an immediate sense that there's potential disaster ahead with people there who were infected and spreading.
sentences.zh: 人们立刻感觉到，随着那里的人被感染并传播病毒，一场潜在的灾难即将来临。

sentences.en: We started talking then to a number of different family members of people who were
sentences.zh: 我们当时开始与许多不同的家庭成员交谈，他们显然很担心，并试图弄清楚如何支持在设施内的家人。

sentences.en: obviously worried and trying to figure out how to support their family members that are inside the facility.
sentences.zh: 显然很担心，并试图弄清楚如何支持在设施内的家人。

sentences.en: You know, one of those people that I talked to one of those first days was Bridget Parkhill.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我在最初几天交谈过的人之一是布里奇特·帕克希尔。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I called Bridget.
sentences.zh: 我给布里奇特打了电话。

sentences.en: And from the first moment we were on the phone, it was clear that she was very frustrated with this experience.
sentences.zh: 从我们通话的第一刻起，就很明显她对这次经历感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: Hi, Bridget.
sentences.zh: 你好，布里奇特。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm fabulous.
sentences.zh: 我好极了。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: I'm reading a little facetiousness in your voice.
sentences.zh: 我听出你的语气里有一点讽刺。

sentences.en: Yes, just a bit.
sentences.zh: 是的，有一点。

sentences.en: It's been a pretty rough week.
sentences.zh: 这周过得相当艰难。

sentences.en: I imagine it has been.
sentences.zh: 我想确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Her mother was in the facility trying to recover from knee surgery.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲在那个设施里，试图从膝盖手术中恢复。

sentences.en: She'd been there for a few months.
sentences.zh: 她已经在那里住了几个月了。

sentences.en: And Bridget and others were just trying to get a handle on what was going on inside.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特和其他人只是想了解里面到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Bridget, what are you thinking when you hear that this nursing home is suddenly in the news and is connected to the coronavirus?
sentences.zh: 布里奇特，当你听说这家疗养院突然上了新闻并与冠状病毒有关时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: Well, it is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实如此。

sentences.en: My mom has been a resident there since November.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈从11月起就住在那里。

sentences.en: She had her knee replaced.
sentences.zh: 她做了膝盖置换手术。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden I'm getting frantic phone calls from my sister saying that two people had tested positive for this coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 然后突然间，我接到了我姐姐打来的疯狂电话，说有两个人检测出这种冠状病毒呈阳性。

sentences.en: One was an employee and one was another resident and that they were on lockdown.
sentences.zh: 一个是员工，一个是另一位居民，他们被封锁了。

sentences.en: So as you get this information, what are you thinking to yourself?
sentences.zh: 那么当你得到这个消息时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: I'm thinking, my God, mom's had a cough since last Tuesday and she needs to get tested right away.
sentences.zh: 我在想，天哪，妈妈从上周二就开始咳嗽了，她需要马上接受检测。

sentences.en: So when I called them, I said, has my mother been tested yet?
sentences.zh: 所以我打电话给他们时说，我母亲接受检测了吗？

sentences.en: And it was a social worker I spoke with and she pulled up mom's chart and she said, no, we're going to test 50 people, you know, and your mom hasn't had a fever.
sentences.zh: 和我通话的是一名社会工作者，她调出了妈妈的病历，说没有，我们要检测50个人，你知道，你妈妈没有发烧。

sentences.en: And she told me mom's last three temperatures and they were fine.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我妈妈最近三次的体温，都很正常。

sentences.en: At that point, they were taking them, I believe, every four hours.
sentences.zh: 当时，我相信他们每四个小时测量一次体温。

sentences.en: Bridget's pressing them to get her mom tested to get a real answer here on whether or not she has the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特正在催促他们为她母亲进行检测，以确定她是否真的感染了冠状病毒。

sentences.en: There's a great fear from her and the rest of the family that this could get much worse.
sentences.zh: 她和家里的其他人非常担心情况会变得更糟。

sentences.en: And if she does, in fact, catch the coronavirus, she's someone who was a really high risk of dying.
sentences.zh: 如果她真的感染了冠状病毒，她属于死亡风险极高的人群。

sentences.en: So what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么发生了什么？

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, we just kept trying to call.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们只是不停地打电话。

sentences.en: We called the King County Health Department because we were told to go through them to see, should we be self-quarantined?
sentences.zh: 我们给金县卫生局打了电话，因为我们被告知要通过他们来了解我们是否应该自我隔离？

sentences.en: Should we be doing something?
sentences.zh: 我们应该做些什么吗？

sentences.en: Basically, should you yourself be quarantined?
sentences.zh: 基本上，你自己应该被隔离吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And I couldn't get a hold of anyone.
sentences.zh: 但我联系不上任何人。

sentences.en: My sister got a hold of someone and they said, oh, this is the wrong number.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐联系上了一个人，他们说，哦，号码打错了。

sentences.en: This is the emergency line.
sentences.zh: 这是紧急热线。

sentences.en: You need to call this other number.
sentences.zh: 你需要拨打另一个号码。

sentences.en: So they were giving us the runaround.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在敷衍我们。

sentences.en: And so finally, this guy said, okay, I'll take your information and someone will give you a call back.
sentences.zh: 最后，那个人说，好吧，我会记录下你的信息，会有人给你回电话的。

sentences.en: Well, no one did.
sentences.zh: 结果，根本没人打。

sentences.en: No one called back.
sentences.zh: 没人回电话。

sentences.en: No one called back.
sentences.zh: 没人回电话。

sentences.en: So she finally got a hold of someone and they said, oh no, if your mom doesn't have a fever, you know, no, you don't have to do anything.
sentences.zh: 所以她终于联系上了一个人，对方却说，哦不，如果你妈妈没有发烧，你知道的，不，你什么都不用做。

sentences.en: You're just fine.
sentences.zh: 你没事的。

sentences.en: And you had explained that your mom was in a facility where coronavirus was known to have infected people.
sentences.zh: 而你之前解释过，你母亲所在的机构已知有新冠病毒感染病例。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that you had been there.
sentences.zh: 而且你去过那里。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Did any of the reactions surprise you?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么反应让你感到惊讶？

sentences.en: Very much so.
sentences.zh: 非常惊讶。

sentences.en: Very much so.
sentences.zh: 非常惊讶。

sentences.en: They just acted like it was no big deal.
sentences.zh: 他们表现得好像这根本没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: And that's a theme that we're hearing from a lot of the family members who are feeling like they're just in an information black hole right now at a time when it seems like there's
sentences.zh: 这也是我们从许多家庭成员那里听到的一个主题，他们觉得现在正处于一个信息黑洞中，而此时似乎

sentences.en: an extreme risk to the health and lives of the people they love.
sentences.zh: 他们所爱之人的健康和生命正面临极大的风险。

sentences.en: I mean, we're seeing an email chain that's going around from Life Care where they emailed a bunch of family members and actually kept all the email addresses open to each other.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们看到了一封在Life Care机构内部流传的邮件，他们给许多家庭成员发了邮件，实际上把所有人的邮箱地址都公开了。

sentences.en: And subsequently, the family members have been responding over and over again with their outrage and frustration and concern.
sentences.zh: 随后，家庭成员们不断地回复，表达他们的愤怒、沮丧和担忧。

sentences.en: They're not getting the information they want.
sentences.zh: 他们没有得到想要的信息。

sentences.en: They have a lot of questions that are not getting answered.
sentences.zh: 他们有很多问题没有得到解答。

sentences.en: There's undoubtedly extreme concern about how people are doing in the facility, their health and their exposure and what kind of protection is available to them.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，人们对机构内人员的状况、他们的健康、接触风险以及他们能得到什么样的保护感到极度担忧。

sentences.en: I mean, it's been heartbreaking to listen to because they feel so helpless.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听着这些让人心碎，因为他们感到如此无助。

sentences.en: They feel like their family members are sort of in this facility and just sitting ducks waiting for this virus to come through.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己的家人就像被困在这个机构里，成了待宰的羔羊，等着病毒蔓延过来。

sentences.en: So as the family members are struggling to get the information and answers that they feel like they need, we get another bout of terrifying information.
sentences.zh: 所以，当家庭成员们努力获取他们认为需要的信息和答案时，我们又得到了另一波可怕的消息。

sentences.en: Some researchers here in the Seattle area had been working to trace the genetic sequences of two cases of coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 西雅图地区的一些研究人员一直在追踪两例新冠病毒病例的基因序列。

sentences.en: They looked at both the first one that showed up in mid-January, you know, six weeks ago now.
sentences.zh: 他们研究了第一例出现在一月中旬的病例，你知道的，那是六周前了。

sentences.en: And then they looked at another case that showed up last week.
sentences.zh: 然后他们又研究了上周出现的另一例病例。

sentences.en: And in their analysis, they can see that these two cases appear to be linked.
sentences.zh: 在分析中，他们发现这两例病例似乎是有关联的。

sentences.en: And what do these genetic sequences of this virus tell us?
sentences.zh: 那么，这种病毒的基因序列告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: So what it indicates is that after the first person who got the coronavirus in Washington state
sentences.zh: 这表明，在华盛顿州出现第一例新冠病毒感染者之后，

sentences.en: six weeks ago, there appears to have been a series of transmissions, you know, a number that we can't
sentences.zh: 六周前，似乎发生了一系列传播，你知道的，数量多到我们现在

sentences.en: even count at this point, that then led to a new person showing up with the virus in more recent days.
sentences.zh: 甚至无法统计，最终导致最近几天出现了新的感染者。

sentences.en: So there's a sign here that this has been spreading throughout the community undetected for weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以这表明病毒已经在社区中悄无声息地传播了数周。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So they're saying that that first case and that last case, they're not isolated cases.
sentences.zh: 所以他们是说，第一例和最后一例并不是孤立的病例。

sentences.en: The genetics show that they are in fact linked through some vast number of transmissions
sentences.zh: 基因分析显示，它们实际上是通过大量的传播链联系在一起的，

sentences.en: that mean that somehow that first person gave it to somebody else who gave it to somebody else who gave it to somebody else and eventually gives it to this last person.
sentences.zh: 这意味着第一位感染者以某种方式传给了别人，那个人又传给了别人，以此类推，最终传给了最后这个人。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So these researchers now believe that if in fact this virus has been spreading throughout the region for six weeks, essentially undetected, that there are likely 300 to 500
sentences.zh: 所以这些研究人员现在认为，如果这种病毒确实已经在该地区传播了六周，且基本未被察觉，那么很可能还有300到500

sentences.en: other cases out there that we don't know about, but potentially up to 1,500.
sentences.zh: 例我们不知道的病例，甚至可能高达1500例。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Two people are now dead in a Seattle suburb today from the coronavirus after state officials confirmed that COVID-19 has been spreading quietly for weeks.
sentences.zh: 今天，西雅图郊区有两人死于新冠病毒，此前州政府官员证实，新冠肺炎已经在悄无声息中传播了数周。

sentences.en: Six weeks.
sentences.zh: 六周。

sentences.en: Six weeks in Washington state.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿州传播了六周。

sentences.en: That means hundreds of undiagnosed cases could be out there.
sentences.zh: 这意味着外面可能还有数百例未被诊断的病例。

sentences.en: And experts suggest there are many more cases circulating that have been detected so far.
sentences.zh: 专家认为，目前传播的病例远不止已检测到的那些。

sentences.en: People have to remember, confirmed cases are not the number of cases.
sentences.zh: 人们必须记住，确诊病例并不代表实际病例总数。

sentences.en: Confirmed cases just means we went through the big rigmarole to get them tested.
sentences.zh: 确诊病例只是意味着我们经历了繁琐的程序才让他们接受了检测。

sentences.en: Mike, once it becomes clear that we're dealing with a real outbreak here, and according to those projections
sentences.zh: 迈克，一旦明确我们正在应对一场真正的疫情，而且根据你刚才提到的那些预测，

sentences.en: that you just mentioned, could be hundreds, could be thousands of people infected, does access to testing for the coronavirus change?
sentences.zh: 可能有成百上千人被感染，那么新冠病毒的检测渠道会有所改变吗？

sentences.en: So the local health officials here were talking very ambitiously about how they were going to be increasing testing.
sentences.zh: 当地卫生官员一直在雄心勃勃地谈论他们将如何增加检测量。

sentences.en: And it was more significant.
sentences.zh: 而且规模确实更大了。

sentences.en: They were doing about 100 tests a day.
sentences.zh: 他们每天大约进行100次检测。

sentences.en: But at the same time, that's 100 per day for the whole state.
sentences.zh: 但同时，这是整个州每天100次。

sentences.en: Their goal is to increase that capacity as time goes on to the point where maybe we're doing more than 1,000 a day.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标是随着时间的推移提高检测能力，达到每天可能超过1000次的水平。

sentences.en: But why aren't they able to just suddenly deploy thousands of tests more or less immediately?
sentences.zh: 但为什么他们不能突然部署数千次检测，或者说几乎立即实现呢？

sentences.en: What holds that back?
sentences.zh: 是什么阻碍了这一点？

sentences.en: Well, part of it is a capacity issue.
sentences.zh: 嗯，部分原因是能力问题。

sentences.en: But the other thing is that while the CDC guidelines on who should be tested have broadened, it's still relatively narrow.
sentences.zh: 但另一件事是，虽然疾控中心关于谁应该接受检测的指导方针已经放宽，但仍然相对狭窄。

sentences.en: The new guidelines essentially say that if you're someone who's hospitalized with unexplained flu-like symptoms, you would get a teSt.
sentences.zh: 新的指导方针基本上说，如果你是因不明流感样症状而住院的人，你就可以接受检测。

sentences.en: But if you're just a random person who has flu-like symptoms and you're concerned that you might have had coronavirus,
sentences.zh: 但如果你只是一个有流感样症状的普通人，并且担心自己可能感染了新冠病毒，

sentences.en: that's not enough for you to go to your doctor and be put in the pipeline to get tested.
sentences.zh: 这还不足以让你去看医生并进入检测流程。

sentences.en: So basically, there are just restrictions still on who's eligible to be tested, and it seems quite stringent.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，关于谁有资格接受检测仍然有限制，而且看起来相当严格。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Their official guidance is not everyone needs to be tested.
sentences.zh: 他们的官方指导意见是，并非每个人都需要接受检测。

sentences.en: So at this point, what's happening to people like Bridget's mother, who has not yet been tested, may have been exposed to this virus?
sentences.zh: 那么在这一点上，像布里奇特的母亲这样尚未接受检测、可能已经接触过病毒的人，现在情况如何？

sentences.en: What is the protocol for people like her?
sentences.zh: 像她这样的人的规程是什么？

sentences.en: What happens to her?
sentences.zh: 她会怎么样？

sentences.en: So right now, a lot of these people are essentially, they're isolated in their rooMs.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，这些人中的许多人基本上都被隔离在自己的房间里。

sentences.en: They're getting food delivered to them by people in protective gear.
sentences.zh: 他们由穿着防护装备的人员送餐。

sentences.en: They're trying to stay in touch with family through video chats and phone conversations.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图通过视频聊天和电话与家人保持联系。

sentences.en: And what is she saying that that's been like?
sentences.zh: 她是怎么形容那种感觉的？

sentences.en: She said, this is like solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 她说，这就像单独监禁。

sentences.en: And, you know, we laughed about, wow, mom, I don't know what your crime was, but you're doing hard times.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们笑着说，哇，妈妈，我不知道你犯了什么罪，但你在受苦呢。

sentences.en: You know, she laughed, you know, because my mom has a very big, bright personality laughing all the time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她笑了，因为我妈妈性格非常开朗，总是笑个不停。

sentences.en: She's that kind of person.
sentences.zh: 她就是那种人。

sentences.en: So she's trying to make light of it.
sentences.zh: 所以她试图轻松地看待这件事。

sentences.en: But at the end of the conversation, she said, I'm just really lonely.
sentences.zh: 但在谈话结束时，她说，我真的感到很孤独。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's hearing through these family members a lot of concern about how this is being handled, how long they're going to be in isolation, and, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，从这些家庭成员那里听到了很多关于这件事处理方式的担忧，他们还要被隔离多久，以及，你知道，

sentences.en: when this might end.
sentences.zh: 这一切何时才能结束。

sentences.en: And the larger, more concerning question, how is this going to end for them?
sentences.zh: 还有一个更大、更令人担忧的问题，这对他们来说将如何收场？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Meaning, are their family members going to survive this?
sentences.zh: 意思是，他们的家人能挺过这一关吗？

sentences.en: That's on their minds all day long.
sentences.zh: 他们整天都在想这个问题。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You know, one of the things that's a real struggle for the family members like Bridget was that they can't see their family members right now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，像布里奇特这样的家庭成员真正挣扎的事情之一是，他们现在无法见到自己的家人。

sentences.en: They can't go into the facility because it's in quarantine.
sentences.zh: 他们不能进入该机构，因为它处于隔离状态。

sentences.en: We're told that they were under lockdown, but I really needed to see my mom.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知他们处于封锁状态，但我真的需要见我妈妈。

sentences.en: And so my sister and I decided to meet there and bring her a little care package because they said that, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我姐姐和我决定在那里见面，给她带一个小护理包，因为他们说，你知道，

sentences.en: we could certainly bring her food or books or whatever we wanted to, and just to call them when we got there.
sentences.zh: 我们当然可以给她带食物、书或其他任何我们想要的东西，只要我们到了那里给他们打电话就行。

sentences.en: So Bridget talks about how the other day she went to the facility, went to the front door.
sentences.zh: 所以布里奇特谈到前几天她去了那个机构，到了前门。

sentences.en: So I called, and they said that someone would be right out.
sentences.zh: 所以我打了电话，他们说会有人马上出来。

sentences.en: And there were signs that said no admittance, that they were having a respiratory outbreak.
sentences.zh: 那里有牌子写着禁止入内，因为他们发生了呼吸道疾病爆发。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So a woman came out and said that she would take it to mom.
sentences.zh: 所以一个女人出来说她会把它带给妈妈。

sentences.en: And I said, wait a minute, we can't go in.
sentences.zh: 我说，等一下，我们不能进去。

sentences.en: Is there any way that I can, like, go around outside to her window and just see her, just wave at her so she knows that I'm here?
sentences.zh: 有没有办法让我绕到外面去她的窗户看看她，只是向她挥挥手，让她知道我在这里？

sentences.en: You know, would it be okay if she walked around the exterior of the building just so she could have a chance to see her mom?
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果她绕着建筑物外面走一走，让她有机会见到她妈妈，这可以吗？

sentences.en: And she said, oh, sure, no problem.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，当然，没问题。

sentences.en: So she took the goodie bag down to mom, and my sister and I went around the side.
sentences.zh: 所以她把礼品袋拿给了妈妈，我和姐姐绕到了侧面。

sentences.en: She opened up the blinds, and there was my mom.
sentences.zh: 她拉开了百叶窗，我妈妈就在那里。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: With all the stuff going on, just seeing her gave me so much relief.
sentences.zh: 在发生了这么多事情的情况下，见到她让我感到如释重负。

sentences.en: Just because we are getting so little information from Life Care Center that we don't know.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是因为我们从Life Care中心得到的信息太少了，我们什么都不知道。

sentences.en: You know, is she able to sit up?
sentences.zh: 你知道，她能坐起来吗？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Is she laying in a bed?
sentences.zh: 她是躺在床上吗？

sentences.en: You know, we had no idea, so it was just thrilling to see her sitting up and smiling and waving.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们根本不知道，所以看到她坐起来、微笑着挥手，真是太令人激动了。

sentences.en: When do you think you're going to be allowed to see your mother?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你什么时候能被允许见到你母亲？

sentences.en: Are they giving you any kind of time frame?
sentences.zh: 他们给你任何时间表了吗？

sentences.en: They've given me no time frame whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 他们根本没有给我任何时间表。

sentences.en: They don't know.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道。

sentences.en: There's ambulances, you know, going in there, you know, and they take people out and take them to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 你知道，救护车进进出出，他们把人带出来送往医院。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So I'm just waiting for that call to say that my mom is one of those people.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是在等那个电话，说我妈妈是其中之一。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，不。

sentences.en: So, Mike, by the end of this past weekend, from everything you've said, the government in Washington has pronounced a state of emergency.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，到上周末结束时，根据你所说的一切，华盛顿州的政府已经宣布进入紧急状态。

sentences.en: It's acknowledging that things are quite serious.
sentences.zh: 这承认了情况相当严重。

sentences.en: Testing is still very limited.
sentences.zh: 检测仍然非常有限。

sentences.en: People are furious about that.
sentences.zh: 人们对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And from the projections you described, it's clear that the virus has been spreading and spreading and maybe at this point kind of out of control.
sentences.zh: 根据你描述的预测，很明显病毒一直在传播，而且此时可能已经有点失控了。

sentences.en: So what is the plan by the authorities there to wrap their hands around this crisis?
sentences.zh: 那么当地当局有什么计划来控制这场危机吗？

sentences.en: So there was really a major shift that was happening because the news was just cascading worse and worse every time.
sentences.zh: 确实发生了一个重大的转变，因为消息每次都变得越来越糟。

sentences.en: I mean, every time they would give us an update, it was more people in critical condition.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，每次他们给我们更新消息，都是更多的人处于危急状态。

sentences.en: It was another death, more deaths.
sentences.zh: 又是另一次死亡，更多的死亡。

sentences.en: You had this growing cacophony of horrible news coming out from the region.
sentences.zh: 该地区传出了越来越多的可怕消息。

sentences.en: And so then on Monday morning, we really see that sort of change in direction and messaging.
sentences.zh: 所以到了周一早上，我们确实看到了方向和信息传达上的那种改变。

sentences.en: This morning, we are in final negotiations to purchase a motel in which we can place patients who are in need of isolation and a place to recover.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，我们正在进行最后的谈判，购买一家汽车旅馆，我们可以把需要隔离和恢复的地方的病人安置在那里。

sentences.en: The county executive here in the Seattle area comes out and says he's not going to be going out to buy a motel in the region that he could repurpose for the sake of isolating people who have coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 西雅图地区的县行政长官出来说，他将购买该地区的一家汽车旅馆，并对其进行改造，以便隔离感染新冠病毒的人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: The risk for all of us of becoming infected will be increasing.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人被感染的风险将会增加。

sentences.en: The county health officer here was talking about how the number of cases here are growing so much that at some point,
sentences.zh: 当地的县卫生官员谈到这里的病例数量增长得如此之快，以至于在某个时候，

sentences.en: coronavirus cases are going to outpace the number of flu cases in the area.
sentences.zh: 新冠病毒病例将超过该地区的流感病例数量。

sentences.en: And there's a potential for many people to become ill at the same time.
sentences.zh: 而且很多人有可能同时生病。

sentences.en: And that means a whole different strategy.
sentences.zh: 这意味着需要一套完全不同的策略。

sentences.en: Now there's so many cases that they no longer have the ability to track individual people and retrace their steps.
sentences.zh: 现在病例太多了，他们不再有能力追踪个人并回溯他们的行踪。

sentences.en: So we are making both individual and community level recommendations to limit the spread of this disease.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正在制定个人和社区层面的建议，以限制这种疾病的传播。

sentences.en: And our community level recommendations are very similar to what we recommend for influenza.
sentences.zh: 我们的社区层面建议与我们对流感的建议非常相似。

sentences.en: There's shifting to a community level approach here that you've got to sort of address the problem at a bigger scale.
sentences.zh: 这里正在转向社区层面的方法，你必须以更大的规模来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So basically, they're giving up on the idea of containing this by tracking each person who has it.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们已经放弃了通过追踪每一位感染者来控制疫情的想法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now,
sentences.zh: 现在，

sentences.en: I just got a message that came in that said the latest guidance is that they are recommending that older residents with underlying health problems in the community stay in their homes.
sentences.zh: 我刚收到一条消息，最新的指导意见建议社区中患有基础疾病的老年居民留在家中。

sentences.en: So, Mike, in the span of really just a few days here, the state of Washington has gone from just a handful of cases to a pretty extraordinary outbreak.
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克，在短短几天内，华盛顿州的情况已经从寥寥几个病例演变成了一场相当严重的疫情爆发。

sentences.en: And it feels like a kind of terrifying demonstration of just how fast this virus can take hold across a relatively small geographical area.
sentences.zh: 这让人感到一种可怕的直观感受，即这种病毒在相对较小的地理范围内传播得有多快。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, we went from one known case a week ago to today, the latest was 39 total infections and 10 people dead.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一周前我们还只有一个已知病例，而今天，最新数据显示总共有39例感染，10人死亡。

sentences.en: You can sense the growing fear around here.
sentences.zh: 你能感觉到周围日益增长的恐惧感。

sentences.en: I mean, we got guidance that employers encourage people to telecommute instead of coming into an office.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们收到的指导意见是鼓励雇主让员工远程办公，而不是到办公室上班。

sentences.en: You've got schools preparing to educate students remotely if the virus continues to spread.
sentences.zh: 如果病毒继续蔓延，学校也正在准备让学生远程上课。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: That could expand also to include, again, discouraging mass gatherings, as we call them, sporting events, the high school basketball game, the hockey game, the convention.
sentences.zh: 这可能还会进一步扩大，再次强调，不鼓励举行所谓的群众集会，比如体育赛事、高中篮球赛、曲棍球比赛、大型会议等。

sentences.en: These things could end up becoming temporarily discouraged, if not possibly prohibited, depending on the escalation of.
sentences.zh: 根据疫情升级的情况，这些活动最终可能会被暂时劝阻，甚至可能被禁止。

sentences.en: Mike,
sentences.zh: 迈克，

sentences.en: how reasonable is it to fear that what happened there in Washington and the speed with which it happened is going to be the story of how this unfolds pretty much everywhere else in the United States?
sentences.zh: 担心华盛顿州发生的事情及其蔓延速度会成为美国其他地区未来情况的写照，这种担忧有多合理？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, we're certainly seeing the spread everywhere at this point.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，目前我们确实看到病毒在各地蔓延。

sentences.en: One thing that I've stopped to think about a number of times in the last few days is,
sentences.zh: 过去几天里，我反复思考过一件事，那就是：

sentences.en: did this region just get really unlucky to have the epicenter of the outbreak take root in a nursing home among the most vulnerable people in the region?
sentences.zh: 这个地区是否只是运气太差，疫情的震中恰好扎根在一家养老院，而那里住着该地区最脆弱的人群？

sentences.en: And is that why the death toll is so high here?
sentences.zh: 这就是这里死亡人数如此之高的原因吗？

sentences.en: At the same time, you know, the reality is the virus is continuing to spread.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，你知道，现实情况是病毒仍在继续传播。

sentences.en: And, you know, the public health experts we talked to expect it to continue that way.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们采访的公共卫生专家预计这种情况还会持续下去。

sentences.en: And there's going to be more places just like this that are going to get hit.
sentences.zh: 未来会有更多像这里一样的地方受到冲击。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 迈克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: And stay safe.
sentences.zh: 注意安全。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: You know, Bridget, for a lot of people, the coronavirus is a kind of distant news story.
sentences.zh: 你知道，布里奇特，对许多人来说，新冠病毒只是一种遥远的新闻故事。

sentences.en: It's very scary, but it's not yet a reality in a lot of places.
sentences.zh: 它很可怕，但在很多地方还不是现实。

sentences.en: In the Seattle area and definitely in this nursing home, it is a reality and a very scary reality.
sentences.zh: 但在西雅图地区，尤其是这家养老院，它是一个现实，而且是一个非常可怕的现实。

sentences.en: And I wonder, as somebody who has experienced it in a very personal and visceral way,
sentences.zh: 我想知道，作为一个以非常个人化和切身的方式经历过这一切的人，

sentences.en: what this experience has taught you about what it's like when this virus does come into your life.
sentences.zh: 这段经历让你对病毒真正进入生活后的感受有了什么了解？

sentences.en: Well, when it comes to your own family, I can't express to you what it is like.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当涉及到自己的家人时，我无法向你描述那种感受。

sentences.en: But it's fear, it's every bad emotion you could have.
sentences.zh: 那是一种恐惧，是你所能感受到的所有糟糕情绪的总和。

sentences.en: And, you know, she calls me first thing in the morning when she wakes up.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她每天早上醒来第一件事就是给我打电话。

sentences.en: Just hearing her voice, it's like, OK, everything's good for another day.
sentences.zh: 只要听到她的声音，我就觉得，好吧，今天又平安度过了。

sentences.en: But, you know, is it going to be fine in an hour?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，一个小时后还会好吗？

sentences.en: Is it going to be fine in three hours?
sentences.zh: 三个小时后还会好吗？

sentences.en: Is she going to make it through the night?
sentences.zh: 她能熬过今晚吗？

sentences.en: Because it hit so fast when the severe illness hit.
sentences.zh: 因为当重症来袭时，病情恶化得太快了。

sentences.en: But I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道。

sentences.en: The Times reports that in February, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，二月份，美国

sentences.en: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention distributed a test for the coronavirus to state and local laboratories.
sentences.zh: 疾病控制与预防中心向州和地方实验室分发了新冠病毒检测试剂盒。

sentences.en: But that flaws in that test led to inconclusive results.
sentences.zh: 但该测试存在的缺陷导致了结果不确定。

sentences.en: A replacement test was promised but was never distributed.
sentences.zh: 虽然承诺提供替代测试，但从未分发。

sentences.en: As a result, most diagnostic testing was only conducted at CDC's labs in Atlanta, whose results took days.
sentences.zh: 结果，大多数诊断测试只能在亚特兰大的疾控中心实验室进行，出结果需要几天时间。

sentences.en: Last week, amid growing criticism from doctors across the country,
sentences.zh: 上周，在全国医生日益高涨的批评声中，

sentences.en: the Food and Drug Administration finally broke the logjam by allowing state and local officials to conduct initial testing on their own.
sentences.zh: 食品药品监督管理局终于打破僵局，允许州和地方官员自行进行初步检测。

sentences.en: But tests remain scarce.
sentences.zh: 但检测试剂依然短缺。

sentences.en: Ms. Chairman, this is really a frightening time.
sentences.zh: 主席女士，现在确实是一个令人恐惧的时刻。

sentences.en: I'm hearing from people who are sick, who want to get tested, are not being told where to go.
sentences.zh: 我从生病的人那里听说，他们想接受检测，却没人告诉他们该去哪里。

sentences.en: I'm hearing that even when people do get tested, and it's very few so far, the results are taking way longer to get back to them.
sentences.zh: 我听说即使人们真的接受了检测——目前人数非常少——结果反馈回来的时间也太长了。

sentences.en: During a hearing on Tuesday, U.S.
sentences.zh: 在周二的听证会上，美国

sentences.en: Senator Patty Murray of Washington State lashed out at federal health officials over the shortage of test kits on behalf of her constituents.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州参议员帕蒂·默里代表她的选民，就检测试剂短缺问题猛烈抨击了联邦卫生官员。

sentences.en: The administration has had months to prepare for this, and it's unacceptable that people in my state and nationwide can't even get an answer as to whether or not they are infected.
sentences.zh: 政府有几个月的时间来为此做准备，而人们在我的州乃至全国甚至无法得到关于自己是否感染的答复，这是不可接受的。

sentences.en: To put it simply, if someone at the White House or in this administration is actually in charge of responding to the coronavirus, it'd be news to anybody in my state.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，如果白宫或本届政府中真的有人负责应对新冠病毒，那对我们州的人来说简直是新闻。

sentences.en: As of Wednesday, there were 44 cases of the virus in Washington State and more than 150 in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 截至周三，华盛顿州有44例病毒感染病例，全美超过150例。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: If you remember, I entered the race for president to defeat Donald Trump, and today I am leaving the race for the same reason, to defeat Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 如果你们还记得，我参加总统竞选是为了击败唐纳德·特朗普，今天我退出竞选也是出于同样的原因，即击败唐纳德·特朗普，

sentences.en: because staying in would make it more difficult to achieve that goal.
sentences.zh: 因为继续留在竞选中会使实现这一目标变得更加困难。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Michael Bloomberg dropped out of the presidential race after a poor performance on Super Tuesday, in which he failed to win a single state,
sentences.zh: 周三，迈克尔·布隆伯格在“超级星期二”表现不佳后退出了总统竞选，他在当天的选举中未能赢得任何一个州，

sentences.en: despite spending hundreds of millions of dollars on his campaign.
sentences.zh: 尽管他在竞选上花费了数亿美元。

sentences.en: From the start, Bloomberg's candidacy hinged on Joe Biden's campaign collapsing, something that never happened.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，布隆伯格的参选就取决于乔·拜登竞选团队的崩溃，但这从未发生。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Bloomberg endorsed Biden, becoming the latest moderate candidate to do so.
sentences.zh: 周三，布隆伯格宣布支持拜登，成为最新一位这样做的温和派候选人。

sentences.en: I've always believed that defeating Donald Trump starts with uniting behind the candidate with the best shot to do it.
sentences.zh: 我一直认为，击败唐纳德·特朗普始于团结在最有希望实现这一目标的候选人身后。

sentences.en: And after yesterday's vote, it is clear that candidate is my friend and a great American, Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 在昨天的投票之后，很明显那位候选人就是我的朋友、一位伟大的美国人，乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Warren, who, like Bloomberg, failed to win any states on Tuesday, remains in the race for now.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦和布隆伯格一样，周二没能赢得任何州，目前仍留在竞选中。

sentences.en: But said she was reassessing her path forward.
sentences.zh: 但她表示正在重新评估未来的道路。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为大家准备节日待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会睡到不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 你可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或任何你喜欢的播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。
